steps.body: Dividing 70 by 10 asks how many tens make 70. Seven tens make 70, so 70 ÷ 10 = 7.
steps.narration: Dividing 70 by 10 asks how many tens make 70. Seven tens make 70, so 70 ÷ 10 = 7.

widget.prompt: Build an array with 10 rows that holds 70 squares.
widget.factorFeedback: That rectangle covers 70 squares, but not as 10 rows of 7. Build the arrangement the fact describes.
widget.successFeedback: 70 split into 10 rows gives 7 in each.
widget.lowFeedback: That is fewer than 70 squares. Keep building until the array is complete.
widget.highFeedback: That is more than 70 squares. The array should stop at 10 rows of 7.

options.label: 7 — seven tens split into ten groups

predict.reveal: 70 is 7 tens; splitting into 10 equal groups leaves 7 in each. Any number of tens split into ten groups leaves the count of tens — and 700 is what 70 × 10 gives, not 70 ÷ 10.
